summary: The minor is 20 units: three core courses, one significant programming course, and the remaining units from the listed CS courses. Every course must be letter graded. You check by hand the 3.0 GPA, and finish the coursework before you enter TGR status.

program.why: Grading: "All courses should be taken for a letter grade."

TRGHUn3n.why: "Remaining courses can be taken from this list." The core and programming courses are part of the minor's 20 units (Minimum Units in the Program: 20), so this list takes the rest and the program total checks the 20; the data asked for 20 units on top of them.
